# Characteristic-zero structure at L=5: g_{2x5}(Q) = sp_512(Q) (+) sp_512(Q)

**[THEOREM] (wave 17, lead).** The dynamical Lie algebra generated by the 23 local terms of the
open 2x5 Ising layer (10 single-site `X_i`, 13 open `ZZ` bonds) inside `gl(1024)` is exactly

    g_{2x5}(Q) = sp_512(Q) (+) sp_512(Q),   dim = 262656,

split on the two `prod-X` parity halves (512-dim each), each half carrying a nondegenerate
alternating invariant form (the signed checkerboard matching of the wave-16 alternation law),
unique up to scalar. This upgrades the wave-16 L=5 point (modular probe only) to an exact
characteristic-zero theorem: set law, dimension law, and form/type law all verified at L=5.

## Proof (COMPUTATION, all steps exact)

1. **Closure set.** Generators are Pauli strings; commutators of Pauli strings are single Pauli
   strings (GF2 symplectic test: `[s,t] != 0` iff `x_s.z_t + z_s.x_t = 1 mod 2`; the product
   string is `xor`). Generator-monotone BFS (ad-generator iteration suffices, generators subset
   span) reaches **262656** distinct strings. Exact Python integers; no linear algebra rank
   estimate anywhere.
2. **Set law at L=5.** Every reached string satisfies the alternation set law
   (`z` even-weight; `z != J`; `(J-z).x = 1 + z.d (mod 2)`; plus the full `z = J` fiber, L odd;
   `d` = checkerboard class): 0/262656 violations. The law set itself counts
   `(2^9 - 1) * 2^9 + 2^10 = 262656`. Hence **reached = S_law at L=5**.
3. **Rank over Q.** Distinct Pauli strings are orthogonal under trace pairing, so
   `dim_Q span(reached) = |reached| = 262656`.
4. **Form / type.** On each 512-dim `prod-X` half the class space is `GF(2)^10 / {a ~ a+J}`;
   the checkerboard `d` (odd weight, `bit0(d) = 1`) induces a fixed-point-free perfect matching
   `pi` (256 pairs). A signed form `Omega` with `Omega(P, pi(P)) = sigma_P`,
   `Omega^T = -Omega`, exists invariant under every reached string iff a GF2 sign system on the
   256 sign bits is consistent. The full system (262656 strings x 512 classes =
   **134,479,872** equations) has **0 contradictions** and exactly **1 connected component**
   (union-find with parity), so `Omega` exists and is unique up to scalar; independent sampler
   re-check: 3200 equations, 0 violations. Hence the closure lies in
   `sp_512(Omega) (+) sp_512(Omega)`; dimensions match, so equality.
5. The `z`-even condition (block-diagonality under `prod X`) holds for very string by
   construction: every generator commutes with `prod X`.

## Significance

- The even-so/odd-sp alternation law (wave 16) now has **three exact char-0 points**: L=3
  (sp_32+sp_32, wave 13/14), L=4 (so_128+so_128, H411), L=5 (sp_512+sp_512, this theorem).
- This is the largest characteristic-zero certified layer-algebra structure to date
  (previous largest: 2x4 at dim 16256).
- The sign-system's connectedness (1 component) also certifies the form's uniqueness —
  matching the wave-16 prediction that "the same signed checkerboard matching" governs both
  halves at all L.
